findings.label: Signed-out optimistic revert on feed reactions
findings.detail: A logged-out viewer clicking a reaction on a real feed post sees a brief optimistic bump that reverts when setReaction returns { ok:false, 'Sign in to react to posts.' }. ReactionBar is driven only by disabled={!post.isReal} with no auth flag. This is explicitly accepted in the design (resolves prior design-review finding #1); informational, not a blocker.
